decisionBox.changed: TWO changes, and they point in opposite directions - which is why confidence eases from 6.5 to 6.0 even though the structural read IMPROVES. THE UPGRADE: the daily candle closed at 64,104.7 at 19:00 COT, above the daily EMA20 at 63,984.15, the first such close of the drawdown after three intraday rejections. Price is above ALL FOUR 1h EMAs (64,001 / 63,728 / 63,624 / 63,768) and ALL FOUR 4h EMAs (63,645 / 63,764 / 63,938 / 64,075), the 4H MACD histogram has widened to +143.23 with the line at +133.11 against a signal of -10.12, and the OKX long/short account ratio has fallen from 2.17 twenty-four hours ago to 1.31 now - crowded retail longs have been flushed out, which is exactly the positioning you want under a reclaim. THE DOWNGRADE: the fuel that was supposed to carry the move has been SPENT. The CoinGlass 19:20 column now reads a literal ZERO at 64,407.79, where midday read 1.11M/1.24M/901K stacked across 140 points, and the OKX realized-liquidation feed confirms why - $5.01M of SHORT liquidations against $563.6K of long liquidations in the last 24 hours, with the single largest cluster at 64,430-64,530 between 18:08 and 18:18 COT. The 24h liquidation total on CoinGlass is $203.97M. With that band consumed, the nearest meaningful pool above is 670.38K at 64,835.53 and the heaviest object in the whole near field is now 830.75K BELOW at 63,338.44. So: structurally better, but the magnet map has flipped from emphatically up to roughly balanced, the 15m has rolled over (RSI 44.41, MACD histogram -34.74, price back under the 15m EMA20 at 64,194.28), and the wallet is 96% invested going into an eight-hour gap. Hence a 10% spot trim and a recommended resting stop rather than a fresh add.

overnightRisk: Next report is the ~02:00 COT midnight session, so this is a six-to-eight hour unattended window, and three specific things make it worth respecting tonight. FIRST, the ETF flow print. Farside's 04 Aug 2026 row was re-read at 19:44 COT and is still entirely blank - every fund shows a dash and the total reads 0.0 - even though US funds reported after the 16:00 EDT close over three hours ago. That number will land during the gap. Context: 03 Aug was +$170.1M, 31 Jul was -$265.4M, and the whole streak is one good print inside a choppy tape, so a negative surprise is live and would hit a market that has just spent its short-side fuel. SECOND, the liquidity asymmetry has inverted. Everything above spot to 64,835 is now thin - the surface literally reads 0 at 64,407.79 - while 468.69K sits at 63,837.47 and 830.75K at 63,338.44 below. A drift lower has something to feed on for the first time in days; a drift higher does not. Daily ATR is 1,581.63 or 2.47% of spot, so a routine overnight range easily reaches 63,338. THIRD, the macro tailwind is fully priced. The S&P 500 closed at a record with VOO +1.81% and QQQ +3.40%, and ALL THREE monthly-DCA tickers - QQQ, VOO and JPXN - now sit in the RICH zone, VOO and JPXN literally at the top of their trailing-21 window. Brent has slipped again to 79.08 in the Asian session after settling around 79.4 following a -5% day, and the 10-year is at 4.619%. That is a benign backdrop, but it is a backdrop that has already done its work; the marginal buyer it was going to bring has arrived. The practical instruction: the resting stop at 63,760 is the only protection that operates while nobody is watching, and there is 7.12 USDT plus tonight's ~19 USDT trim waiting for a tag of 63,338 that holds. Do not chase a break above 64,521 in thin overnight liquidity - there is 670K at 64,835 to run to and very little between, which cuts both ways.

atr.source: Computed here (Wilder ATR-14) from 720 completed Kraken XBTUSDT daily bars ending with the 2026-08-04 candle, which CLOSED at 19:00 COT (Kraken's daily bars are UTC-stamped, so the endday session sits right after the daily close). calibration.note: Two honest marks against the record. First, midday's 15m bearish divergence was wrong - price broke higher through it within three hours. Second, midday framed the 62,194.78 pool as a 890.14K magnet that had 'survived six consecutive reports unconsumed and GROWN'; on tonight's surface that neighbourhood reads 276.69K at 61,983.93, so it decayed rather than grew. The lesson carried forward is that heatmap cells are a snapshot of live leverage, not a standing order book, and describing one as 'growing' across sessions over-reads the data.
